description: Search Trip.com rental cars for an airport pickup and drop-off, with exact local dates and times, the driver's age and the licence's issuing country. Ask for a missing age or licence country; never guess either. Trip.com quotes a 30 to 60 driver-age band for that range, while supplier eligibility uses the real age. Returned prices are rental totals, not daily rates, and deposits sit outside them. Links open a search the traveler completes: they confirm the vehicle, the policies and the final price there. There is no in-app booking, and a failed source never means no cars exist. Retains an account-bound result for 30 minutes for later display. Does not reserve a car or spend credits. Returns data plus display.resultId; call display_card to show it. presentation (optional) shapes what is shown without changing the action: compact or full layout, and only the limit, ids or sections this tool advertises.

driverAge.description: The driver's actual age; ask, never guess

dropoffAirport.description: Drop-off airport IATA code; defaults to the pickup airport

licenseCountry.description: The driving licence's issuing country, ISO2; ask, never guess

maxTotalAmount.description: Rental-total ceiling in integer minor units of currency

minSeats.description: Keep only cars with at least this many seats

pickupAirport.description: Pickup airport, exact IATA code. Resolve a city name with search_flights first.

layout.description: Compact cards or the full view; keeps booking, add and error actions available.

transmission.description: automatic = self-shifting gearbox | manual = stick shift

name: search_car_rentals
title: Search rental cars
